name: impairment_reversal_ceiling_leverage_covenant_headroom
question_template: Equipment cost {COST} USD, depreciated straight-line over {LIFE} years to zero residual, with depreciation charged each year-end. At end of year 2, after depreciation, the recoverable amount is {REC1_PCT}% of cost and the asset is written down to it; depreciation then continues straight-line on the written-down amount over the remaining life. At end of year 3, after depreciation, the recoverable amount is {REC2_PCT}% of cost. A reversal is recognized only if positive and cannot lift the carrying amount above the depreciated cost had no impairment occurred. After any reversal, other assets total {OTHER_ASSETS} USD and total liabilities are {LIAB} USD. A covenant caps total liabilities divided by total assets at {COV_MAX}%. Compute covenant headroom: cap minus actual ratio in percentage points (negative if breached).

slots.description: Impairment loss recognized at end of year 2.
Carrying amount at end of year 3 before any reversal.
Depreciated cost at end of year 3 had no impairment occurred.
Impairment reversal recognized at end of year 3, zero if none.

program:
def solve():
    cost = Fraction(P["COST"])
    life = Fraction(P["LIFE"])
    rec1 = cost * Fraction(P["REC1_PCT"]) / 100
    rec2 = cost * Fraction(P["REC2_PCT"]) / 100
    other_assets = Fraction(P["OTHER_ASSETS"])
    liab = Fraction(P["LIAB"])
    cov_max = Fraction(P["COV_MAX"])

    cv2 = cost * (life - 2) / life
    if rec1 >= cv2:
        raise ValueError("recoverable amount at year 2 must be below carrying amount for an impairment")
    loss = cv2 - rec1

    cv3_pre = rec1 * (life - 3) / (life - 2)
    ceiling = cost * (life - 3) / life
    capped_target = min(rec2, ceiling)
    reversal = capped_target - cv3_pre
    if reversal < 0:
        reversal = Fraction(0)
    cv3 = cv3_pre + reversal

    total_assets = other_assets + cv3
    ratio_pct = Fraction(100) * liab / total_assets
    headroom = cov_max - ratio_pct

    return {
        "final": headroom,
        "impairment_loss": loss,
        "carrying_pre_reversal": cv3_pre,
        "reversal_ceiling": ceiling,
        "reversal_recognized": reversal,
    }
